result.title: F$^3$NO: Frequency-Decomposed Finite-Time Flow-map Neural Operators with Cross-Scale Conditioning
result.summary: Neural operators enable fast PDE forecasting, but repeated predictions accumulate errors and fine-scale structures remain difficult to resolve. We introduce a frequency-decomposed finite-time flow-map neural operator (F$^3$NO) that leverages updated low-frequency features to guide nonlinear refinement of high-frequency information. Within each layer, this cross-scale conditioning connects global spectral processing with local detail refinement. The model directly predicts states at specified future times and adjusts the contributions of the two branches according to the prediction interval. For longer trajectories, it combines parallel predictions within short temporal segments with recursive propagation between segments. Experiments on five PDE benchmarks demonstrate improved forecasting accuracy over autoregressive and direct-prediction baselines. Ablations show that frequency-decomposed refinement can improve accuracy with fewer parameters, while the benefits of segmentation depend on spatial resolution and dynamical regime.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出频域分解的有限时间流映射神经算子 F³NO：逐层用低频特征条件引导高频细节的非线性细化，并按预测间隔调节两分支贡献，长轨迹上采用短时段内并行预测、段间递归传播，在五个 PDE 基准上优于自回归与直接预测基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「段内并行预测＋段间递归传播」及按预测间隔调权重的状态传播方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的 parallel/loop 混合生成、动态计算与长度泛化提供可核查的方法线索，跨尺度低频引导高频也可类比多尺度状态更新，但领域较远、需人工判断可迁移性。
